name: View-Adaptive Voxelization
definition: A view-dependent voxelization technique for homogeneous particle-based simulation data that computes compressed voxelizations at resolutions exceeding available GPU memory by adapting to the viewport and using a span-based surface representation.
summary: View-Adaptive Voxelization is a GPU-friendly, real-time technique that renders particle-based media by computing view-adaptive binary voxelizations with on-the-fly compression, requiring no preprocessing.
